propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from immutable CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared kernel, respecting effective disables, project DET criteria, file applicability, and explicit dollar budgets.

When one criterion fails, code review must retain successes from independent criteria and return INDETERMINATE only if blocking-capable coverage is missing, otherwise PASS if only advisory coverage is absent.
Positive authored usd_budget values must be enforced and shed before calls; zero budget must be rejected by validation; omission remains uncapped.

Code review must preserve authored topology, base-reviewer payload, per-overlay context, prompt contracts, model resolution, sequential scheduling, and checkpoint absence while adding internal versioned discovery trace.
File-scoped project criteria must execute zero times with stored reason when inapplicable, and exactly once when applicable, without exposing trace details in review response.
Systemic configuration/provider setup failures and cancellation must stop remaining work with exact usage accounting and fail-safe behavior without signed or hollow pass verdict.
